text.en: Believing Liouville's theorem is a special property of gases made of many particles — it holds for any Hamiltonian system at all, including a single frictionless pendulum, purely because Hamilton's equations make the phase-space flow divergence-free; the number of particles is irrelevant.
text.et: Arvamus, et Liouville'i teoreem on paljudest osakestest koosnevate gaaside erijoon — see kehtib iga Hamiltoni süsteemi jaoks, sealhulgas ühe hõõrdumatu pendli jaoks, ainuüksi seetõttu, et Hamiltoni võrrandid teevad faasiruumi voo divergentsivabaks; osakeste arv ei ole oluline.
